title: Graph revision reducer decomposition
description: Objective: reduce the graph-revision reducer below the permanent file-size cap by extracting result/error/state-clone responsibility. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6. NOT in scope: contract changes, new transitions, graph mutation rules, planning-run changes, or test rewrites. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.ts and packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-results.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
